resources.string: The whole app switches at once. You can change it later in Settings.

There is no account and no server. Your entries, receipts and settings are stored only on this phone. To keep a safe copy, use Back up now in Settings: it saves one file protected by a passphrase you choose.
When an SMS arrives from a bank or wallet sender you allow, Masroof turns it into an expense on this phone. The text is never sent anywhere. Android will now ask you to allow receiving SMS.
SMS capture is off - you can turn it on in Settings

Masroof can read the bank and wallet messages already in your inbox and turn them into entries. It happens in the background on this phone, and you can keep going meanwhile. Choose how far back to read.
Past messages can\'t be read without permission, so reading did not start. You can start it later in Settings.
Some bank apps send a notification instead of an SMS. Android will open a screen where you allow Masroof to read notifications; Masroof only looks at the banking apps you allow, on this phone.
Who else spends in this household?
Optional. Add one name so you can tell who paid. It is only a label on this phone, not an account.
Enter a name up to %1$s characters
Open Wallet to see your entries. You can run this guide again any time from Settings.
A few quick steps to turn on SMS capture and read your past messages.
Go through the setup steps again: language, SMS, notifications and the household.
